name: Rally Raid Roadbook
description: Digital roadbook reader for Rally Raid stages: the roadbook made in the stage builder's editor scrolls with the trip odometer. Box up / down (Ctrl+Shift+PgUp / PgDn), sync the trip to a box (Ctrl+Shift+End). RECCE: record the driven line, mark, confirm, move, retag or delete boxes as you drive, and let the car detect jumps, crests, compressions, soft sand and slopes (Ctrl+Shift+R).
author: Rally Raid for BeamNG.Earth
